evidence.description: Compared all 33 REQs (REQ-BILL-001 through REQ-BILL-033) and 4 NFRs against 2weeks-spec.md sections 5-8, implementation-design-mvp.md sections 2-5, and tdd-acceptance-matrix-mvp.md T-P0-02 through T-P0-05
All 33 REQs and 4 NFRs reviewed line-by-line

spec_fidelity.summary: Three HIGH severity findings on step ordering contradictions between behavioral spec and source documents (FIND-001, FIND-004, FIND-007). One HIGH severity finding on missing environment variable validation requirements (FIND-002). Multiple MEDIUM findings on missing safety invariants (FIND-006), missing requirements for PAY.JP API format (FIND-003), incomplete CORS preflight spec (FIND-012), hash computation gap (FIND-014), and timezone purity concern (FIND-015).

evidence.description: All 74 PROPs reviewed. Traceability matrix verified: every REQ-BILL-XXX has at least one PROP. Tier assignment reviewed for feasibility.

Traceability matrix (lines 236-275) verified against REQ list. All 33 REQs and 4 NFRs have PROP coverage. PROP tool selections (Vitest, fast-check, testcontainers) are feasible for the described tests.

verification_readiness.summary: One HIGH severity finding on missing end-to-end orchestration ordering verification (FIND-009). Two MEDIUM findings on incomplete failure scenario coverage (FIND-010, FIND-011). The traceability matrix is complete (every REQ has PROPs), but the PROPs themselves lack depth at critical failure boundaries. Individual PROP tool selections are feasible.

summary: FAIL on both dimensions. The behavioral spec covers the billing-service domain comprehensively (33 REQs, 4 NFRs, well-defined purity boundary) but contains critical ordering contradictions with the source documents in the subscribe and cancel step sequences (FIND-001, FIND-004, FIND-007). Missing environment variable validation requirements from 2weeks-spec.md section 9 (FIND-002). Missing safety invariants for PAY.JP write retry prohibition (FIND-006). The verification architecture has complete traceability (every REQ maps to PROPs) but lacks end-to-end orchestration ordering tests (FIND-009) and granular post-write failure scenario coverage (FIND-011). The spec requires iteration to correct ordering contradictions and fill identified gaps before proceeding to TDD phase.
